vault.title: Pahofisi Yemunhu
vault.subtitle: Nzvimbo yemunhu pachake inongovhurwa chete mubrowser uye haigoni kuverengwa neserver seyakarurama.
vault.setup_description: Kiiki yepahofisi inogadzirwa mubrowser. Server inochengeta chete kiiki yakaputirwa uye marekodhi akaencrypted.
vault.setup_warning: Kana ukarasikirwa nemapassword ese maviri evault uye kiyi yekudzorera, data haigoni kudzorerwa.
vault.passphrase_placeholder: Sarudza password yakasimba ine mavara anosvika 12 zvakanyanya
vault.protection_item_1: Zita rechinhu, tsananguro, barcode, mutengo, zuva, uye minda yewaranti zvinovharirwa mubrowser.
vault.protection_item_2: Seva inoona chete tsamba yakavharirwa, huwandu hwezvinhu, uye timestamps.
vault.protection_item_3: Kuburitswa kwekutanga kunonyanya kuvanzika uye kwakatarisana nemavara; kugovera uye midhiya zvinoda nzira yakasarudzika yakachengeteka.
vault.unlock_description: Unogona kuvhura vault nepassphrase yako kana kiyi yekudzorera yawakachengeta kare.
vault.security_note_1: Ki yechivande inogara chete mumemory yebrowser. Inobviswa paunobuda papeji kana kuvhara chivande.
vault.security_note_2: Kana ukakanganwa pasipasi, unogona kushandisa ki yekudzoreredza. Kana zvose zvakarasika, zvirimo hazvichawanikwi zvachose.
vault.recovery_ready_description: Tinoratidza ki iyi kamwe chete. Iichengete panzvimbo yakachengeteka.

preview.title: Maitiro ekutarisa
preview.body: Chikamu chebackend chepeji ino hachisvikiki panguva yekuyedza kwemuno parizvino. Uchiri kukwanisa kuongorora marongerwo uye kuyerera kwepeji kutanga; tichabvumidza chikamu cheserver mushure mekunge wabvumidza.

legal.privacy_policy_content: Kuvanzika kwako kwakakosha kwatiri. Chikumbiro ichi chinoshandisa kuchengetedza zvakachengeteka dhata yako yawakatumira uchishandisa encryption panzvimbo yega yega. Hatitengesi kana kugovana dhata yako yega nevamwe vanhu kana makambani. Nekushandisa sevhisi iyi, unobvuma kuunganidzwa kwe data inodiwa kuitira kutungamira account yako uye kushanda kwechikumbiro.
legal.terms_of_service_content: Nekushandisa {{brandName}}, unobvuma mitemo iyi. Sevhisi inopihwa 'sezvazviri' pasina waranti. Iwe une mutoro wedata raunokwirisa uye nekuona kuti une kodzero nadzo. Isu tine kodzero yekumisa maakaundi anotyora mitemo kana kushandisa zvirongwa zvisiri pamutemo.
legal.register_consent: Ndaverenga, ndanyatsonzwisisa, uye ndinobvuma <1>Mitemo yeSevhisi</1> uye <2>Mutemo Wezvekuvanzika</2>.
legal.consent_subtitle: Ndapota simbisa mazwi aripo usati waramba uchifambira mberi.
legal.consent_notice: Tinoda kusimbiswa kwakanyorwa kweMazwi eBasa aripo uye Chiziviso cheKuvanzika usati wapedza kushandisa application.
legal.consent_checkbox: Ndinobvuma Mazwi eBasa uye ndinosimbisa kuti ndaverenga Chiziviso cheKuvanzika.
legal.consent_required: Unofanira kusimbisa Mazwi eBasa uye Chiziviso cheKuvanzika usati waramba uchifambira mberi.

cookies.banner_text: Isu tinoshandisa makuki anokosha kuti urambe wakapinda pamwe nekuvimbisa kuchengeteka kweseshoni yako. Nekuramba uchishandisa saiti ino, unobvuma mitemo yedu.
